frame.origin: site centre; z = 0 at the lowest terrain point

heightmap.indexing: z = hm[i, j] at x = x_min + j*res, y = y_max - i*res (row 0 = north edge, max y)

rock_fields.z: base of the mesh (embedded below ground) [m]
rock_fields.scale: mesh scale (variant OBJ has unit horizontal extent)
rock_fields.source: hirise = detected in the 0.25 m ortho, procedural = Golombek-Rapp model

terrain.note: Sim-only ground truth. The brain must never read this block or the two .npy maps.
terrain.patch_map: terrain_patches.npy (int16 patch id on the heightmap grid, -1 = default)
terrain.slip_definition: 1 - v_actual / v_commanded at nominal speed on flat ground

textures.layout: image row 0 = north edge (y_max); USD st (0,0) = (x_min, y_min)
textures.normal_space: tangent space, +X east, +Y north (OpenGL, green up)
textures.normal_content: detail below the 0.5 m mesh only (mesh normals carry the rest)
textures.displacement_content: fine height minus bilinear heightmap (no pebbles), 16-bit linear in that range
textures.surface_fields: surface_fields.npz (inputs of surface.py, for chunk / close-up maps)

sun.note: azimuth from north, clockwise; default matches the HiRISE image so baked shading agrees

source.dataset: HiRISE DTM + RED orthoimage via USGS Astrogeology STAC (COG)
